verdict.rationale: n8n documents self-hosting on your own infrastructure, on-premises, or in a private cloud, which lets you control where workflow data lives. Community users cite self-hosting as their way to keep client data in-house. The caveat is that you get residency control only by running the infrastructure yourself; nothing shows region selection for n8n's own hosted cloud. Missing for 10: documented cloud region/data-residency selection, explicit data-residency or compliance documentation, independent verification of residency guarantees.
